How to find your ring size at home with a phone or paper

By the Metre team · Updated 26 Oct 2026 · 3 min read

Short answer

The most reliable way is to measure the inside diameter of a ring that already fits. A US size 7 has an inside diameter of about 17.3 mm (0.68 in) and an inside circumference of about 54.4 mm, which is UK N½ and about EU 54. On a phone, calibrate the screen with a bank card first, because screens differ.

What you need

  • A ring that fits the same finger well, or a strip of paper and a ruler
  • A bank card (85.6 mm wide) if you use an on-screen sizer
  • The evening, when fingers are at their largest

Step by step

  1. Measure a ring that fits

    Measure across the inside of the ring, edge to edge, in millimetres. Do not measure the outside. Use a ring that fits the same finger and sits over the knuckle without being loose.

  2. Or measure your finger with paper

    Cut a strip of paper, wrap it round the base of the finger, mark where it overlaps and measure the length in millimetres. That is the circumference. Divide by 3.14 for the diameter.

  3. Convert with the chart below

    Match the diameter or circumference to the nearest size. Between two sizes, choose the larger, especially for wide bands.

  4. Measure at the right time

    Fingers are larger in the evening and when warm, and smaller when cold. Measure at room temperature and repeat on a second day.

  5. On a screen, calibrate first

    Place a standard bank card on the screen and match its width, so the circle shows true size. Then lay the ring on the circle and match the inside edge.

Ring size chart

USUKInside diameterInside circumference (≈ EU)
5J½15.7 mm (0.62 in)49.3 mm
6L½16.5 mm (0.65 in)51.9 mm
7N½17.3 mm (0.68 in)54.4 mm
8P½18.1 mm (0.71 in)57.0 mm
9R½19.0 mm (0.75 in)59.5 mm
10T½19.8 mm (0.78 in)62.1 mm

Charts differ slightly between brands and countries. Treat this one as a guide and check the maker's chart when you order a ring.

Do it with Metre

Ring sizer Pro

  1. Calibrate once with a bank card in Settings → Calibrate screen with a bank card.
  2. Open Ring sizer and put a ring that fits on the circle.
  3. Use the slider or − and + until the circle just touches the inside edge.
  4. Read the US, UK, EU and JP sizes and save them.

Measure the inside of the ring, not the outside. Ring sizer is part of Metre Pro.

iPhone and iPad, iOS 17 or later. Get Metre on the App Store.

How accurate is this?

An on-screen ring sizer is only as good as the screen calibration and how carefully you match the edge. A difference of half a millimetre can be half a size. Use it to get close, and confirm with a jeweller's sizer for a ring that is a gift or hard to resize.

Measurements made with a phone are estimates. Before you cut, order or build, confirm critical dimensions with a physical tape.

Questions people ask

How do I measure my ring size at home?

Measure the inside diameter of a ring that fits, or wrap paper round your finger and measure the length. Then convert with a size chart.

What size is a 17.3 mm ring?

An inside diameter of 17.3 mm is about US 7, UK N½ and EU 54.

Should I size up for a wide band?

Often yes. Wide bands fit more tightly, so if you are between two sizes, choose the larger one.

Is a phone ring sizer accurate?

It can get you close if the screen is calibrated, but it is an estimate. A jeweller's sizer is the reference for anything important.
